versions.changelog:
- No behavior or instruction changes are shown in `SKILL.md`.
- Six reference files changed; `skill-card.md` was removed.

- Added workflow and guidelines for handling 2.5D character or object baked sprite sequences via new reference.
- Updated build process to address repeated failures in feel or visual issues by requiring review of public solutions from established titles before further changes.
- Required explicit conflict reporting or documentation updates when implementation diverges from approved GAME_DESIGN or ART_DIRECTION.
- Enhanced production stage: mandate direct side-by-side screenshot comparisons of final assets with approved target images; after two rounds with no improvement, remaining differences must be documented as limitations instead of updating target art.
- Removed outdated skill-card documentation.
Authorized ZenStory cold-start distribution; immutable source and preserved notices.
